The paper analyzes publicly available metagenomes (n=6,874) and newly sequenced non-Westernized cohorts (n=272 metagenomes from Ghana, Ethiopia, Tanzania, Madagascar). Sample-level extraction limited to newly sequenced cohorts with demographic detail.

DNA extraction kit 'PowerSoil' is stated for the newly sequenced non-Westernized datasets; publicly available metagenomes do not specify extraction methods.
